# Ingredient

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

Something that goes into a drink.

- Abstract: it has no members of its own, only its subclasses do.
- Subclasses: [Chocolate](c-chocolate.md), [Coffee](c-coffee.md), [Foam](c-foam.md), [Gelato](c-gelato.md), [Milk](c-milk.md), [Water](c-water.md), [WhippedCream](c-whipped-cream.md)
